record.what_it_does: All-in-one CRM, marketing automation, and agency platform with a broad public REST API.
record.auth_notes: Two supported methods: Private Integration Token (single sub-account, internal use) and OAuth 2.0 (public integrations, webhooks). A multi-user toolkit would use OAuth 2.0 via a Marketplace app. The old API v1 keys are not covered in the docs I fetched.
record.access_notes: Developers create Marketplace apps in the Developer Marketplace. I did not confirm a free tier. Using the API needs a HighLevel account, which is generally paid, and I could not verify the plan. The Marketplace nav links to "App Review Guidelines", which suggests review is needed before public distribution. I did not open that page.
record.api_breadth_notes: API v2 covers contacts, opportunities, calendars, conversations, invoices, products, locations, users, social, workflows and more. I did not count operations; this is an estimate.
record.mcp_notes: Vendor-hosted at https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2. Other clients have their own paths, such as /mcp/openai/v2/ and /mcp/cursor/v2. It signs in with a HighLevel login, with no API key.
record.blocker_notes: Public OAuth distribution likely goes through Marketplace app review, and the API needs a HighLevel account. Private Integration Tokens work for building and testing on one sub-account. Neither the app-review terms nor the sandbox or plan details were verified.

record.needs_human: Check three things. First, the Marketplace App Review Guidelines, to see what public OAuth distribution requires. Second, whether a HighLevel developer or agency account is free or needs a paid plan, and whether a sandbox sub-account exists. Third, whether the OpenAPI JSON files are in the GitHub repo. The hint highlevel.stoplight.io is the legacy docs host. Current docs are at marketplace.gohighlevel.com.
